candidate_process.architecture_summary: Two-entry circular buffer with head pointer and occupancy counter, no combinational bypass, supporting simultaneous transfer when full.

items.claim: The module must have exactly two storage entries, preserve FIFO order, and support simultaneous transfer when full without changing occupancy.
in_ready is high when occupancy < 2 or when a simultaneous output transfer occurs, allowing full queue to accept new input.
out_data is zero when out_valid is low, and stable under backpressure.
Reset synchronously clears occupancy, out_valid, and out_data.
Chosen architecture: circular buffer with two registers (data[0], data[1]), 2-bit occupancy counter, and 1-bit head pointer.
head points to the oldest valid entry; tail is derived as (head + occupancy) % 2 for most writes, except during simultaneous full transfer where write goes to head slot.
out_valid is combinational from occupancy > 0; out_data is combinational from data[head] when valid, else 0.
On positive clock edge, synchronous reset takes priority: occupancy=0, head=0, data[0]=0, data[1]=0.
When input_transfer and output_transfer occur simultaneously with occupancy=1, write in_data to tail=(head+1)%2, set head to tail, occupancy stays 1.
When input_transfer and output_transfer simultaneously with occupancy=2, write in_data to head slot, set head to (head+1)%2, occupancy stays 2.
When input_transfer only: if occupancy=0, write to head, head unchanged, occupancy=1; if occupancy=1, write to tail=(head+1)%2, head unchanged, occupancy=2.
When output_transfer only: if occupancy=1, occupancy=0, head unchanged; if occupancy=2, occupancy=1, head=head+1.
Occupancy never exceeds 2 and never goes below 0.
out_valid is 1 iff occupancy != 0.
in_ready is 1 when occupancy < 2 or (occupancy == 2 and out_valid and out_ready).
When empty and in_valid and out_ready, only the input is accepted (out_valid remains 0 for that cycle).
When out_valid and !out_ready, out_valid and out_data remain stable.
Module declaration with parameters and ports as per frozen semantics.
Internal registers: data[0:1], head, occupancy.
Combinational logic for out_valid, out_data, in_ready, and next state signals.
Sequential logic for state update on posedge clk, synchronous reset.
Complete synthesizable RTL code in the rtl.code field.

notes: All item IDs are unique across stages.
Architecture uses a circular buffer with head pointer and occupancy counter.
No combinational bypass: out_data reads from registered storage only when valid.
Simultaneous transfer when full writes to the consumed head slot, preserving occupancy 2.
Reset clears all registers to zero.
